policies.always-R: Select complete MP4 for every public question.
policies.always-D: Select uncached derived digest and frames for every public question.
policies.always-DC: Select shared-episode cached derived digest and frames for every public question.
policies.always-I: Select question-aware temporal-index frames for every public question.
policies.first-R-then-I: For each video select R on its first question, then I on every later question, counting only earlier questions in the frozen schedule.

policy_visible_fields: current public question and video identity
outcome_matching: Use exactly the observed question-and-arm route. For DC, require the replayed cache hit/miss to equal the verified route's state; otherwise mark unsupported, never fabricate a counterfactual outcome.
build_accounting: Charge question-independent captions, video index, and derived materialization once per video when first required; charge question embedding and query-specific frame projection per I question; keep build and query costs separate.
provider_cost_basis: Recorded input and cached-input and output tokens multiplied by frozen official model/region list prices; not actual invoice payment.
vm_allocation: Allocate shared VM and Root cost by recorded experiment-time interval; missing historical build durations remain unknown, never zero.
ranking_rule: Compare quality and full-path list-price cost only if both are observed and all required cost components are present. Otherwise report partial known cost and no winner.
